name: Hartford County, CT
findings: Hartford County has 3,472 nonprofit organizations. 1,658 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,373 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hartford County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 36 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 14 in similar places of this size.
